title: Clean storefront title and price layout
summary: Remove surrounding rules and restore a coherent price treatment with a crisp product heading.

changes.detail: Removed the divider below the brand row and below the price, plus the separate small-decimal styling.

Use a 23px semibold charcoal title (21px compact), consistent 28px green price digits, and readable 13px inline currency. Tightened spacing to group title and price. Locale formatting and purchase calculations are unchanged.
